intro: Tarindrella is a dryad found watching over the sheltered woods of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. As a daughter of Cenarius, she works closely with night elf protectors to investigate the unnatural corruption afflicting the World Tree's wildlife.

sections.t: A Daughter of Cenarius in Shadowglen
p: Dryads are fierce caretakers of nature, born of the demigod Cenarius. While many remain deep within ancient Kalimdor forests like Ashenvale, Tarindrella dwells in the protected glade of Shadowglen atop the boughs of Teldrassil. She acts as a vital bridge between the wild spirits and young night elf defenders taking their first steps outside Aldrassil. Her primary concern is the lingering taint creeping into the forest, tasking reliable adventurers with driving back local pests and gathering clues about the root of the affliction.

Despite Teldrassil's grandeur as the new crown of the night elf people, its pristine groves harbor an unexpected sickness. The once-peaceful furbolgs have deserted their homes to gather as the Gnarlpine tribe, and grells and grellkin tainted by wicked Fel Moss infest the hills around Shadowglen. Tarindrella suspects the Fel Moss behind these changes and directs initiates to confront the grells and bring back samples, seeking to stem the corruption before it can overtake the sanctuary of the young grove.
